page.overview:
Who is Kirigun?

Kirigun is the main antagonist in the IDW Snake Eyes - Deadgame comic series created by Rob Liefeld.

The 5 issue Deadgame IDW comics series by Rob Liefeld is story that pits Snake Eyes and friends against ancient gods and original superheroes.

Using the Dead Sword in ancient times, The Grave Master fought Norse god Thor. In modern time ninjas resurrected Kirigun as a red mummy.
